complete_findings.category: import target authorization freshness and period selection
complete_findings.root_cause: files.import-targets is called with start/end, but changing either date invokes change() which fences preview only and leaves the previous targets list and selectionRef intact. prepare() can send the old selectionRef from a different period without rediscovering.
complete_findings.causal_reproduction_static: Discover planner targets for January, select one, change date range to February without Discover; change() preserves state.targets/selectionRef; selectedTarget() still matches the January selection and prepare() calls files.import-admit using that stale target. Backend reauthorization could reject, but this UI does not enforce fresh period-scoped target selection.
complete_findings.expected: On changes to start/end clear selected target and period-bound target list, require fresh authorized import-targets discovery; producer must additionally deny stale/foreign selections.
complete_findings.impact: Wrong-period destination intent and misleading authority in import review; no unauthorized commit has been proven.
complete_findings.recheck: Owner157 clears period-scoped selection; 150 verifies January→February forces rediscovery, stale/revoked target denied, no admit/preview/apply with old selectionRef; 132 verifies postimage.
